topic: ML API frequency code updates and deployment
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on debugging discrepancies in unit counts when selecting facilities for analytics queries. It was noted that manually selecting specific facilities resulted in a higher count of units compared to the default selection.

[p3] requested updates to the `facilityLevelFrequencyCodes` constant within the ML API code, specifically adding codes 7952 and 7942. A Jira task (DOOH-1842) was created for this purpose.

Later in the day, [p3] requested a re-deployment of the `ml-api` stage to staging, which was eventually completed by [me].
decisions: Add facility codes 7952 and 7942 to the ML API's frequency code constant.
Re-deploy the ml-api stage to staging.
action_items: Implement changes for facility codes 7952 and 7942 in DOOH-1842.
